info.title: Hydracept Public API
info.description: Discovery, quoting, durable jobs, artifacts, and receipts. Public integration surface for Hydracept capabilities and jobs. Authenticate with a Hydracept API key (Bearer). Implementation internals are not part of this contract.

post.description: Resolve semantic suitability, then project authenticated access truth.
HTTP alias of POST /quote. Same 0.3 RetailEstimateResponse (pricing.quote).
0.3 retail quote. Nested pricing.quote is financial authority. Does not reserve or charge funds.
Preserve both sealed billing authority and the Image 2.5 model selection.

availableFundingSources.title: Availablefundingsources
availableFundingSources.description: Funding provenance known at workspace-access time. Managed mixed funding may be reported as unknown until admission seals the exact allocation.

estimateId.title: Estimateid
estimateId.description: Inbound alias of quoteId. Internals consume quoteId / pricing.quote.

accessDecision.description: Authenticated workspace access for this match. Null for anonymous resolution. Suitability and current runnability are separate facts.

quoteId.title: Quoteid
quoteId.description: Commission quote for a capability REQUEST. Humans pay at approvalUrl. Never pass this id as execution.quoteId on jobs or invoke.

notExecutionQuoteId.title: Notexecutionquoteid
notExecutionQuoteId.description: This quoteId is not valid for job execution.quoteId.

CapabilityResolutionRequirements.title: CapabilityResolutionRequirements
CapabilityResolutionRequirements.description:
Supported resolver constraints.

Requirements are deliberately small and closed. Hydracept must reject a
requirement it cannot honor instead of accepting arbitrary keys that silently
disappear. ``runnableNow`` is evaluated only with authenticated workspace
context; catalog-only resolution cannot answer it.

ComputeLevel.title: ComputeLevel
ComputeLevel.description: Provider-neutral inference effort requested by the routing authority.

autoSelect.title: Autoselect
autoSelect.description: Opt in to smart fallback when preferredModel is physically unavailable. Ignored when preferredModel is omitted.

requestSnapshot.title: Requestsnapshot
requestSnapshot.description: Canonical submitted request for Studio re-run (not receipt).

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: Sanitized human-gate payload. Present only while the job awaits approval.

HydraceptJobResult.title: HydraceptJobResult
HydraceptJobResult.description: First-class job result projection — typed output plus payload identity.

estimatedCost.title: Estimatedcost
estimatedCost.description: Deprecated 0.2 shim of pricing.quote.customerTotal. Do not use internally.

actualCost.title: Actualcost
actualCost.description: Deprecated 0.2 shim of pricing.charge.customerCharge. Do not use internally.

estimateId.title: Estimateid
estimateId.description: Inbound/outbound alias of quoteId. Internals consume quoteId / pricing.quote.

HydraceptReceiptPricing.title: HydraceptReceiptPricing
HydraceptReceiptPricing.description: Canonical 0.3 money model. 0.2 micros fields are serialization shims.

HydraceptSampling.title: HydraceptSampling
HydraceptSampling.description: Optional product-requested sampling. Providers that reject custom sampling omit these.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: Hydracept price before transactional tax. ``amountMicros`` is authority.

PresentationMoney.title: PresentationMoney
PresentationMoney.description: Optional converted display of a charge. Not part of the financial receipt.

RetailEstimateRequest.title: RetailEstimateRequest
RetailEstimateRequest.description:
Quote request using the same canonical envelope as invoke/jobs.

0.3 quote-only shims (``billingMode``, ``options``, top-level ``model``)
are normalized before this closed envelope is validated. Downstream request
semantics are ``context`` / ``input`` / ``execution``; the serializer below
is only an adapter to the existing pricing engine's input shape.

estimateId.title: Estimateid
estimateId.description: Inbound/outbound alias of quoteId. Internals consume quoteId / pricing.quote.

RetailEstimateResponse.title: RetailEstimateResponse
RetailEstimateResponse.description: 0.3 retail quote. ``estimateId`` / top-level charge fields are serialization shims.

estimateEndpoint.title: Estimateendpoint
estimateEndpoint.description: HTTP alias of quoteEndpoint (same 0.3 retail quote).

ScaledFxRate.title: ScaledFxRate
ScaledFxRate.description: FX snapshot using scaled integers — never IEEE binary floats.

SurfaceActionInputField.title: SurfaceActionInputField
SurfaceActionInputField.description: Generic action input. Values are collected by the host and sent as operation input.

ValidationGate.title: ValidationGate
ValidationGate.description: Objective check that may accept a cheap attempt or trigger escalation.

HydraceptApiKey.description: Machine credential issued by Hydracept. Send as Authorization: Bearer <HYDRACEPT_API_KEY>.
